title: Parser

fields.name: key_name
fields.description: Specify field name in record to parse.

fields.name: parser
fields.description: Specify the parser name to interpret the field.

fields.name: preserve_key
fields.description: Keep original Key_Name field in the parsed result.

fields.name: reserve_data
fields.description: Keep all other original fields in the parsed result.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The Parser Filter plugin allows for parsing fields in event records.
